methods.failure_signature: The native tab bridge rejected the supplied conversation reference before any message mutation.
methods.recovery: Use the user-authorized browser fallback with the exact conversation destination and verify the visible title before composing.

methods.failure_signature: The previously preserved browser tab no longer belonged to the current browser session.
methods.recovery: Create one new hidden in-app browser tab at the exact user-supplied conversation destination and verify its visible title.

methods.failure_signature: The native thread read surface was unavailable through the current dynamic tool bridge.
methods.recovery: Continue through the already authorized browser fallback without creating, forking, or substituting a conversation.

methods.failure_signature: A duplicate, ambiguous, or unverified consultation send would violate the one-shot delivery contract.
methods.recovery: Send once only after action-time user confirmation and stop resends after accepted, pending, opaque, or unresolved delivery.

boundary: All routing failures remain zero-credit. The accepted advisory send is delivery evidence only and cannot become mathematical, empirical, professional, production, legal, cultural, Maori-authority, identity, consciousness, independent-reproduction, proof, canon, or Stage 20 evidence.
